snippet.title: COCOBOY - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist COCOBOY on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3589190/COCOBOY/

COCOBOY is a 2D puzzle platformer within a 3D retro gaming simulation. Hack your way through an 80's-inspired cult classic using clever combos of modded abilities. Scour a 2000's-era gaming forum for hints and rumors, and collect rare merchandise from online resellers.
